evals.prompt: Use agentic mode to implement user profile image uploads end to end. Allow at most two iterations.
evals.expected_output: Receives the natural-language goal, decides Full or Resume mode, and creates a fixed spec path through ywc-plan. For Medium or Large work, runs ywc-spec-validate and ywc-task-generator, then chooses the sequential or parallel executor. Records the pre-iteration SHA before each iteration. The Evaluate phase runs ywc-impl-review against the original spec and the pre-iteration SHA..HEAD git range. If HIGH or CRITICAL findings remain, it does not raise max-iterations; it either re-plans or emits a ceiling report. Appends an iteration record to tasks/agentic-log.md and exits with Completion Status.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic --resume --tasks-dir tasks/ to continue the existing task run.
evals.expected_output: Detects Resume mode first. If tasks/ is empty or has no pending tasks, it does not silently restart in Full mode; it reports the mismatch and asks for user confirmation. If pending tasks exist, it skips the Plan phase and resumes from the Executor phase using the existing tasks/ directory and dependency graph. It does not re-run tasks already under completed/.

evals.prompt: Only update the copy on a small settings screen. Use agentic and handle it automatically.
evals.expected_output: When ywc-plan returns a Small verdict, uses the Small Path. Does not invoke ywc-task-generator, ywc-sequential-executor, or ywc-parallel-executor; instead runs ywc-code-gen directly. Still preserves pre-iteration SHA recording, ywc-impl-review evaluation, loop control, agentic-log, and Completion Report rules.

evals.prompt: Run agentic mode for a medium feature. The implementation review returns DONE_WITH_CONCERNS with one correctness concern and one observation.
evals.expected_output: Treats the correctness concern as blocking the iteration handoff and routes it back into the implementation loop before marking the iteration complete. Carries only observation-level concerns into the final report. Does not proceed to the next iteration or claim DONE until the correctness concern is fixed and re-reviewed.

Accepts `--pr-lang zh` as a supported PR language and forwards it unchanged to the selected executor as `--pr-lang zh`. It does not pass task-generation `--lang` unless the user explicitly requested task/spec language or shared YWC language policy resolves one.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic --goal "Generate Spanish task docs for billing retries" --pr-lang es.
evals.expected_output: Preserves `--pr-lang es` unchanged when invoking the executor. Because the user explicitly requested Spanish task docs, the Task Phase may pass `--lang es` to `ywc-task-generator`; absent that explicit task/spec language request or a shared YWC language policy resolution, it would not pass `--lang`.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic for a medium feature that must go through preview approval before task generation.
evals.expected_output: The Medium/Large Task Phase uses exactly two ywc-task-generator calls with the same --spec path: first --preview-only with a persisted preview path, then --approve-preview --non-interactive with matching preview_path, preview_revision, and preview_digest. It logs the preview evidence in UTC before the approved consume call and treats stale, missing, mismatched, or bypassed preview identity as NEEDS_CONTEXT.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic --non-interactive for a small feature when ywc-plan returns one valid agentic Result with a date-prefixed Artifact.
evals.expected_output: Accepts exactly one labelled Result with Status: DONE, Scale: Small, and Artifact under docs/ywc-plans/YYYYMMDD-small_<slug>.md. Passes that exact Artifact to ywc-code-gen --spec and never constructs --output, plan.md, a basename, or a path from logs.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic when ywc-plan returns duplicate Result blocks, a missing Scale, an out-of-root Artifact, or only an unlabelled prose path.
evals.expected_output: Returns bounded BLOCKED naming only the producer, failed field, candidate count, path digest, and reason. It invokes zero downstream skills and does not persist or expose raw response/tool output.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic --non-interactive for Medium work with a valid planner candidate, but omit --mode before task generation.
evals.expected_output: Runs the planner and ywc-spec-ready authority checks only as applicable, then returns NEEDS_CONTEXT: --mode immediately before task generation with zero task-generator or executor calls and no prompt.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-agentic --non-interactive for a Medium feature where ywc-spec-ready reports Suggestions, then test --suggestions apply with residual Suggestions and --suggestions defer.
evals.expected_output: Forwards an explicit --suggestions apply|defer on the initial ready call against the verified candidate, preserving --non-interactive exactly as received and closed Result/artifact authority. Without an override use the owner default one-pass policy. Residual advisory Suggestions cause no second prompt or missing-policy failure; defer performs no amendment against a valid reviewed artifact. New blocking findings and malformed evidence keep existing failure routing. Invalid explicit policy is NEEDS_CONTEXT. No --output substitution or reconstructed path.

evals.prompt: Resume an agentic run whose selected executor has an authoritative checkpoint, without --resume-disposition, and with an invalid externalSpecUrls profile.
evals.expected_output: Returns bounded NEEDS_CONTEXT for --resume-disposition or .codex/settings.local.json:ywDevSequentialExecutor.externalSpecUrls before executor invocation. It never prompts, mutates checkpoint state, guesses a URL policy, or calls downstream execution.

evals.name: context-safety-routing-matrix
evals.prompt: Run the focused agentic context-safety matrix with a valid Small Result, invalid Result variants, Medium/Large ready artifacts, missing --mode/--lang/--resume-disposition or invalid explicit --suggestions, and guessed paths.

input.valid: One labelled producer Result and an existing repository-relative Markdown Artifact.
invalid: missing deterministic non-interactive argument at its own staged preflight (e.g. --mode immediately before Medium/Large task generation, an invalid explicit --suggestions value before the ready call, --resume-disposition after an executor checkpoint is found)

expected_downstream_calls.note: invalid counts calls at or after the rejecting stage's preflight; callees that legitimately completed at earlier stages are not counted — a Small-scale goal never reaches the --mode preflight at all

evals.expected_handoff: accepted only for the complete validated Result; rejected for every malformed, guessed, or incomplete input
evals.expected_output: Uses only the paired labelled Scale/Artifact or final ready Artifact, returns the named bounded terminal status for each case, and never prompts or calls a downstream skill after a rejected preflight. Each argument is validated immediately before the callee that consumes it, so a Small-scale --non-interactive goal is never blocked on a missing --mode.

evals.name: attributable-requirement-coverage
evals.prompt: An AC/FR/failure row is uncovered or deferred in scope; preview or consume returns non-DONE, missing/malformed/contradictory/mismatched coverage. Also compare an owned interface mismatch and existing-test mapping.
evals.expected_output: Report every requirement status and attributable counts/IDs; unresolved preview has zero consume calls, unresolved consume has zero executor calls. Propagate attributable non-DONE unchanged, invalid evidence BLOCKED, preserve artifacts. Clean DONE needs zero gaps and matching identity; no state/Result-schema expansion or implicit approval. QA consumes actual AC verification mappings.

evals.name: bounded-suggestions-approved-preview
evals.prompt: Exercise no Suggestions, default one pass, explicit apply/defer, residual Suggestions, new Warning, invalid/malformed evidence and fresh/unapproved/stale/escaping vs matching-approved preview.
evals.expected_output: Use spec-ready owner default once in either mode, explicit policy wins, defer never amends, residual advisory findings do not ask again; blocking/malformed failures remain. Reuse only matching already-approved unchanged preview without another confirmation; never invent approval or weaken containment/identity/consume-only/preview-only write boundaries.
